name: ILDC facts-only TF-IDF + Logistic Regression baseline
task: binary ILDC outcome-label prediction using source labels 0 and 1 without reinterpreting their semantics
selection_protocol: Fit TF-IDF on eligible training inputs only. Select C by validation accuracy; break ties by the smaller C. Refit the selected pipeline on eligible train plus validation inputs once, then evaluate the test split once. Do not tune after test evaluation.
